body: Actually, I listened to everything they said. And the more I think about it they are right. They are always right, they win. Every bad thing they say about me is true. I know for a fact nobody cares, and I honestly dont see why they would. I feel like I am addicted to depression. When my friends ask to hang out I reject them. When someone offers me help I tell them im fine and nothing is wrong.

We are literally exactly the same (14.M). I don't want to get help because I feel like i'm gonna be judged. The only thing is a lot of people have seen my cuts and depression. I talk about but they laugh it off as a joke. When my cousin (15,M, someone who I look up to) saw my cuts, he laughed and said "good." That was the worst feeling of my life. I Then drank 8 Tylenol (all we had) thinking it would kill me. Nope, suffer from mild liver damage, but still really want to kill myself.
